_meta.description: Fit a vector battery once, score another panel against it, and save it as a population. A compose `fits` entry runs MAT_COVARIANCE over the six survey ratings (survey.pulse, q1-q6) on panel a only, once, before any slot: the bound vector fit carries panel a's per-member means and covariance at full precision (`fits.panel_a.vector`: operator, labels, basis, n, mean, covariance). The panel_b slot then reads that state instead of its own rows: ATTR_MAHALANOBIS `fit: panel_a` scores each panel b respondent's squared distance D² from panel a's distribution (mean about 6.6 against the 6 a same-population draw would average; p95 about 14.7), and MAT_FACTOR `fit: panel_a` emits panel a's two-factor geomin solution without folding a row (members align to the fit BY LABEL; a fit-bound matrix refuses groups, missing and max_drop_share). `save` writes the bound fit as populations/panel_a.pulse-population.json under the data root (PULSE_MODEL_OVERWRITTEN warns when it replaces a file); 06_population_score.json loads it in a later request. An embedder can also register population files at pulse.New (Options.Extensions.Populations, keyed by name, or PULSE_POPULATIONS_DIR, named by file stem); a registered population is bound in every request without a `populations` entry.
_meta.name: compose-vector-fit-save
